descriptions.w3d_target_cursor_create_80118bf0: Allocates a target cursor, initializes its shadow field and registers it.
descriptions.w3d_target_cursor_release_80118c68: Releases a target cursor and destroys its shadow and base when its reference count reaches zero.
descriptions.w3d_target_cursor_tick_80118edc: Updates target cursor state and forwards a retained object to its update helper.
descriptions.w3d_target_cursor_dispatch_80118f5c: Routes active target updates to the camera-mode callback and forwards other messages.
